description: Hand-written safety-critical agricultural advisory sentences that stress the three failure modes (terminology, dosage numbers, negation). Used for the motivating baseline diagnostic; a superset becomes part of the gold test set after Bengali post-editing.

sentences.en: Apply Tricyclazole at 0.6 gram per liter of water to control rice blast.
Do not drain the water from the field during the flowering stage.
Spray Imidacloprid at 0.5 ml per liter against brown planthopper.
Do not apply urea within 10 days before harvest.
Mix 1.12 liter of the pesticide in 50 liter of water.
Use neem oil if you do not want to use chemical pesticides.
Late blight affects potato in cool and wet weather.
Apply 250 kg urea, 150 kg TSP, and 100 kg MOP per hectare.
Never spray insecticide during the midday heat.
Drain the field two days before applying fertilizer.
Bacterial blight causes yellow leaves and wilting in rice.
Do not exceed 2 grams per liter, because a higher dose can burn the crop.
